# AI agent instructions

1. Read `CLAUDE.md` first — it holds the rules, pillars, and coding standards.
2. Then read `docs/ONBOARDING.md` (stack, commands, folder map) and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (diagrams, flows).
3. Business context lives in `docs/project-context.md` and `docs/business/`.
4. Before starting a task, open the matching skill in `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` and follow it.
